AITECH DEFENSE SYSTEMS INC was awarded a contract by National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

The obligated amount is $15,381,506.30.

NAICS 334111. PIID 80GRC027C0003.

Set-aside: NO SET ASIDE USED..

Competition: NOT COMPETED.

NASA awarded a definitive contract to AITECH Defense Systems Inc. valued at approximately $15.4 million. The contract, which runs from November 2026 through November 2027, was not competed. The company will design, fabricate, procure, test, verify, and document reactor control box hardware for the SR-1 Freedom Mission according to the contract's statement of work and related specifications. The work falls under electronic component manufacturing and was awarded without a small business set-aside. AITECH Defense Systems Inc. will be responsible for delivering hardware that meets NASA's technical and documentation requirements for this space mission application.

DELOITTE & TOUCHE LLP was awarded a contract by SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION.

The obligated amount is $4,253,509.15.

NAICS 541519 (OTHER COMPUTER RELATED SERVICES). PIID 28321327FA0010010. Parent award PIID 28321323A00040005.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The Social Security Administration awarded Deloitte & Touche LLP a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $4.3 million for other computer-related services. The award, signed on November 15, 2026, supports federal identity, credential, and access management authentication architecture and integration efforts. The call runs through November 14, 2027, and was awarded through full and open competition. This procurement falls under the parent agreement numbered 28321323A00040005.

I TECH AG LLC was awarded a contract by Department of Commerce.

The obligated amount is $1,787,554.

NAICS 541513. PIID 13ADFL27F0001. Parent award PIID 13ADFL26A0001.

Competition: FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION.

The U.S. Census Bureau issued a blanket purchase agreement call to I TECH AG LLC for field consultant and operations technical support services related to decennial census activities. The call, valued at $1,787,554, was awarded on November 13, 2026, following full and open competition and is based on a master agreement established under the Department of Commerce. Work under this call will be performed from November 13, 2026, through February 1, 2027. The engagement supports automated training initiatives for the 2028 Census Test, providing technical expertise to assist Census Bureau operations during this critical testing phase.
